Hello Daniel and Johannes,
After double-checking with the quality team, I can confirm that the issue is likely due to the PLC. To proceed, please start by testing with a new DP cable. Additionally, if possible, kindly verify the functionality of the DP cable(old) by testing it with another charger.
In the event that the issue persists even after replacing the DP cable, I recommend replacing the KF1 (PLC).
MLFB No.
6ES7677-2DB40-0AA0 -KF1
kindly follow the DC spare RMA process and send the defective part to the mentioned address for quality analysis before submitting warranty claim, within 30 days of repair.
